text.p: Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA /Plc has re-opened its freight Shuttle service, which had been closed since a fire last November, executive chairman Patrick Ponsolle said on Thursday.
"Le Shuttle freight service has been running since yesterday," Ponsolle told reporters at the presentation of its debt restructuring prospectus.
The service will run at one departure per hour on a trial basis with customers travelling free, building up to three departures per hour by June 15, he said.
The return of service is an essential part of getting shareholder and bank approvals for the plan to restructure Eurotunnel's 69.4 billion francs ($12.1 billion) of bank debt.

A fire broke out on a lorry on a Shuttle on November 18, badly damaging a section of the Tunnel and disrupting commercial service. The Inter Governmental Commission gave the all-clear on May 22 for the resumption of Shuttle freight service after a report criticising Eurotunnel's procedures. ($ = 5.749 French Francs)
